import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the iris dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Pivot the data to create a DataFrame with species as index and columns as sepal/petal measurements
pivoted_iris = iris.pivot_table(values=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'], index='species', columns=['sepal_width'], aggfunc='mean')

# Create a heatmap using seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.heatmap(pivoted_iris, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', linewidths=0.5, square=True)
plt.title('Mean Sepal/Petal Measurements by Species')
plt.xlabel('Sepal Width (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Species')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.yticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
